summary: Ran `composer require --dev phpunit/phpunit:^12.0` — PHPUnit 12.5.14 installed with all 25 dependencies.
Added `autoload-dev` PSR-4 mapping (Tests\\ → tests/) and `scripts.test` alias to composer.json.

Created phpunit.xml at project root with bootstrap=vendor/autoload.php, colors=true, stopOnFailure=false, and three named test suites: parsing (tests/Parsing/), selectors (tests/Selectors/), dom (tests/DOM/).
Created tests/Parsing/, tests/Selectors/, tests/DOM/ directories.
Ran `composer dump-autoload` and verified `vendor/bin/phpunit --version` outputs PHPUnit 12.5.14.

comments.note: src/simple_html_dom.php uses the PHP 8.4-deprecated predefined local variable `$http_response_header` on lines 99, 102, 113, and 120. PHP 8.4 emits Deprecation notices on every autoload. The fix is to replace reads of `$http_response_header` with `http_get_last_response_headers()` after the `file_get_contents()` / `fopen()` call. This is out of scope for WP-001 (constraint: must not modify src/simple_html_dom.php) but will produce noisy test output and should be addressed in a dedicated WP before the library targets PHP 9.

summary: Reviewed composer.json and phpunit.xml against all acceptance criteria and the four Review Dimensions.

composer.json: require-dev constraint ^12.0 is correct; autoload-dev PSR-4 mapping Tests\\ → tests/ is idiomatic; scripts.test uses bare 'phpunit' which Composer resolves via vendor/bin PATH injection — acceptable pattern.
phpunit.xml: XSD schema location, bootstrap path, and all three test suite definitions are correct and minimal. stopOnFailure=false is an appropriate default for a library.
tests/ directory tree (Parsing/, Selectors/, DOM/) matches phpunit.xml configuration exactly.
No blocking issues found. All acceptance criteria verified independently. Pre-existing indentation inconsistency in composer.json autoload block was not introduced by this WP.
PHP 8.4 deprecation noise from src/simple_html_dom.php is pre-existing, already tracked as medium debt by both Developer and QA — no action required here.

comments.note: scripts.test uses 'phpunit' rather than 'vendor/bin/phpunit'. Both are equivalent because Composer injects vendor/bin into PATH during script execution, but 'vendor/bin/phpunit' is more explicit and self-documenting for contributors unfamiliar with Composer's PATH manipulation. Non-blocking suggestion for a future tidy-up pass.

phpunit.xml could benefit from a <coverage> element stub to document the intent to add coverage reporting in later WPs. Not needed now and deliberately left out to keep the scaffold minimal — this is the right call for WP-001.

PHP 8.4 $http_response_header deprecation in src/simple_html_dom.php (lines 99, 102, 113, 120) will pollute all test output for WP-002 through WP-005. Already flagged by Developer and QA. Recommend ensuring a dedicated WP is on the backlog to replace these reads with http_get_last_response_headers() before CI is wired up.
